cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Warmth with a Countdown
cards.instruction: Perform increasing warmth with increasingly final language, as though every act of care might also be a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've packed sandwiches for your journey. Put the soft ones on top, please; you deserve a proper meal when you arrive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm only going to the next town. I'll be back by seven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take dinner as well in case seven becomes later. Keep it in the cool bag; I don't want you depending on strangers to feed you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring the bag and containers back tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep them, sweetheart. Please take the lids that fit; I want you properly equipped. No need to bring anything back for my sake.
